compatibility.notes: Resume may optionally use git or tracker writes only when current/repository instructions authorize them; optional authority is not self-granted.

do_not_use_when.text: No checkpoint exists and the current state must be established from scratch via Repository Truth
The next work is a multi-session effort that requires Recon rather than a single slice

use_when.text: A verified checkpoint or handoff names a bounded next slice or recoverable continuation point
The repository state and the named continuation can be reconciled before dependent work begins

evidence_outputs.description: Evidence for the completed continuation slice.
evidence_outputs.name: slice_receipt

evidence_outputs.description: Compact operational state for the next session.
evidence_outputs.name: continuation_handoff

inputs.description: Prior verified handoff or work summary describing current state and explicit continuation.
inputs.name: checkpoint

inputs.description: Repository containing the state to reconcile and continue.
inputs.name: repository_scope

outputs.description: Implemented and validated next coherent slice when authorized by the checkpoint/current invocation.
outputs.name: completed_slice

outputs.description: Exact continuation state, validation evidence, and remaining work.
outputs.name: updated_handoff

preconditions.description: The checkpoint or governing roadmap identifies a bounded next slice or recoverable continuation point.

capability.purpose: Verify a prior checkpoint against the workspace and execute the explicitly named next coherent slice without rediscovery drift.

requirements.description: Important checkpoint claims are checked against the actual repository before dependent work begins.
The named slice's required acceptance evidence is executed and recorded.
Final state names the verified revision, evidence, limitations, and next authorized frontier.
